notes: Access: robots.txt (fetched via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131; safari15_5/safari17_0 hit a Vercel bot-checkpoint interstitial but chrome/edge/firefox profiles passed cleanly) allows crawling; no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web disallow found, so no WAF-bypass ethics issue. Site is genuinely Kave Home (Spanish design-furniture DTC brand; homepage lists 11 physical Spanish stores, real customer-service phone/email) -- Rule 3 sanity check passed, no closing-down language. Locale /es/en/ (lang=en-ES) renders fully in English already, confirmed against the mega-menu HTML and every category page's own English pageName field -- no Dutch/Spanish translation was needed for this company. Category tree taken from the site's own English mega-menu (embedded server-rendered <nav> HTML on the homepage) plus robots.txt sitemaps (category-sitemap.xml -> es/en/categories-sitemap.xml) to catch categories not surfaced in the top nav (bathroom-lamps, lighting-for-teens, childrens-wall-decor, the four Kave Gallery sub-mediums). qty verified via the site's own Algolia InstantSearch payload embedded server-side in each category page's Next.js RSC stream (appId EQ79XLPIU7, index product_es_en): every row's nbHits was checked against ceil(nbHits/hitsPerPage)==nbPages (hitsPerPage stable at 96 across all ~40 pages fetched) as the Rule 1 exhaustion proof, and several (Ceiling Lamps and Shades, Portable Lamps, Outdoor Lighting, Plants and pots, Painting and graphic arts, Sculpture and volume, Textile art, Kave Gallery) additionally carried Algolia's own exhaustiveNbHits:true flag. Excluded per rules: Light bulbs (bulb, 13), Home fragrance/Scented candles/Air fresheners (fragrance rule), Artificial plants and the 'Plants and pots' aggregate (70, mixed rollup of artificial + real pot stands -- kept only the real 'Plant pot stands' child, 46), Bathroom accessories (32, sample titles = soap dispensers/toothbrush holders/toilet-roll holders/towel rails -- bathroom hardware, Rule 0.4 exclude) and Bathroom organization (13, sample titles = storage/laundry baskets -- storage, exclude), Kitchen accessories (22, mixed functional utensils/oil cruets overlapping Trays), Pots and jars (7, filter=food_storage, functional), Chopping boards/Cutlery/Table linens (functional or textile), 'Accessories' (98, filter=sofa_accessories -- furniture, not decor), and 'Decor and accessories' (363, filter=decoration_accessoires -- the master mixed rollup of the whole Decoration menu branch, dropped per the mixed-rollup rule since its children are individually captured). Rule 0 gains: included Bathroom Lamps (8) and Lighting for Teens (44) even though neither appears in the main Lighting mega-menu (found via sitemap) -- both are genuine room-based lighting listings and would have been skipped under the old room-word-exclusion habit; also kept Bathroom Mirrors (11) and Hallway Mirrors (31) as their own rows alongside Wall/Standing Mirrors. Rule 0.6 overlap documented: Mirrors (parent, its own Algolia count is 54) is less than the sum of its four children (42+21+11+31=105), proving a single mirror product is tagged into multiple room/type sub-categories -- all four are still emitted as the site's own genuine nav branches. Same overlap pattern for Wall Decor (75 vs children summing to 70, five uncaptured loose items), Decor Accessories (76 vs children 26), Dinnerware Sets (46 vs children summing to 55), and Kave Gallery (175 vs its four sub-medium children summing to 189) -- all four kept as parent grouping rows per the hierarchy contract (parent rows carry no qty of their own so the mismatch is moot). Two menu-label/URL mismatches worth flagging for future workers: the URL/menu-slug 'lamp-shades' actually serves ceiling/pendant lights (Algolia filter pendant_lighting, page's own pageName='Ceiling lamps and shades'), while genuine fabric/paper lampshades live at 'light-shades-and-accessories' (filter lamp_shades); and Kave Gallery's 'mixed-media' slug actually serves the site's own 'Mixed media' page which nonetheless carries filter kave_gallery_ceramics. Canonical links use https://kavehome.com/es/en/o/<slug> (no www; matches each page's own <link rel=canonical>).
